title: Shin app ne amsar? Bayanai, teburi da farashin dandamali

say: Shin app ne amsar? Bayanai, teburi da farashin dandamali.
Wannan shine bidiyon don module ɗaya na No-Code App Development.

Maginin ƙa'idar da ba ta da lambar zai baka damar ƙirƙirar ƙa'idar aiki ta zaɓin fuska, filaye da dokoki, maimakon rubuta lamba. A ƙasa, kowane app yana da sassa uku. Bayanai, bayanan da yake adanawa.

say: Kuma dabaru, dokoki game da abin da ke faruwa da lokacin. Mai gini ya rubuta lambar. Aikin ku shine tsara waɗannan sassa uku da kyau.

items: Data: bayanan da yake adanawa

Logic: dokoki game da abin da ke faruwa

say: Masu ginin kirki sun san lokacin da ba za su yi gini ba. Yi amfani da kayan aiki mafi sauƙi wanda ke aiki: maƙunsar rubutu, sannan tsari, sannan no-code app, sannan lambar al'ada.
Misali, Nneka tana gudanar da taron bitar dinki a Aba tare da dalibai uku. Mutane hudu suna buƙatar ganin umarni, don haka maƙunsar rubutu na sirri bai isa ba.

say: Samfurin bayanan shine tsarin abin da app ɗin ku ke adanawa da yadda guntuwar ke haɗawa. Fuskokin fuska suna da sauƙin canzawa. Tsarin bayanai ba.
Doka ta ɗaya: tebur ɗaya kowane irin abu. Guji ginshiƙai kamar Abu1, Abu2, Abu3. Wannan yana karya ranar da abokin ciniki ya kawo abubuwa hudu.

panel.heading: Dokoki guda hudu don samfurin bayanan ku
items: Tebu ɗaya kowane irin abu

Tables masu haɗi tare da ginshiƙan Ref
Zaɓi nau'in shafi na dama

say: Doka ta biyu: kowane jere yana buƙatar maɓalli, ƙima daban ga kowane jere. Sunaye suna yin maɓalli mara kyau, saboda abokan ciniki guda biyu ana iya kiran su Blessing.

say: Bisi tana da teburi guda huɗu: Abokan ciniki, Jerin Farashi, Oda da Kayayyakin oda. Kowane abu na oda jeri ɗaya ne, an haɗa shi da odar sa da abinsa.

card.title: Tsarin wanki na Bisi, app ɗin ya yi aiki

say: Kowane jimillar layi shine farashin lokuta masu yawa. Riguna 4 sun samu naira 3,200. 2 wando suna yin 2,000. 1 duvet shine 5,000.

card.title: Tsarin wanki na Bisi, app ɗin ya yi aiki

say: Jimlar odar Naira 10,200 ne, app ɗin ya ƙididdige shi. Ƙara sabon nau'in abu yana buƙatar sabon layi, ba sabon shafi ba.
Gargadi ɗaya. Don kuɗi, kwafi farashin cikin layin oda lokacin da aka ƙirƙira shi. In ba haka ba, ƙara farashin rigar cikin shiru ya canza umarni na watan da ya gabata.

card.title: Tsarin wanki na Bisi, app ɗin ya yi aiki

say: Masu sana'a suna gaya wa abokin ciniki iyaka da wuri. Na farko, kulle-kulle. Idan farashin ya tashi, motsi shine sake ginawa.

cards.d: Fuskoki da dokoki suna rayuwa akan dandamalin mai siyarwa. Motsawa sake ginawa ne, kodayake bayanan ku a cikin Sheets ya kasance naku.
Yawancin dandamali suna cajin kowane mai amfani kowane wata. App na ma'aikata 40 na iya kashe kuɗi fiye da kuɗin gini kowace shekara.
Aikace-aikace masu goyan bayan maƙunsar bayanai suna raguwa yayin da allunan ke girma sosai ko tsarin suna yin nauyi.

say: Na biyu, farashin kowane mai amfani, wanda zai iya zama girma fiye da kuɗin ginin ku.

say: Ana biyan kuɗin ginin ku sau ɗaya. Ana biyan kuɗin dandamali kowane wata, yawanci ta abokin ciniki. AppSheet kyauta ne yayin da kuke yin samfuri, tare da masu amfani da gwaji har 10. Don turawa, abokin ciniki yana buƙatar shirin da aka biya.

card.title: Farashin AppSheet na Nneka na wata-wata

say: A kan Starter, a kusan dalar Amurka 5 ga kowane mai amfani, Nneka zai biya dalar Amurka $20 a wata, kimanin naira 32,000.

card.title: Farashin AppSheet na Nneka na wata-wata
rows: Mai farawa: 4 masu amfani a $5 US

say: Tana son kowane mai koyo ya ga umarnin kansa kawai. Wannan yana buƙatar matattarar tsaro, waɗanda ke buƙatar Core. Don haka tana kashe kusan dalar Amurka 40 a wata, kusan naira 64,000. Ya kamata ta ji haka kafin ta amince da kowane kuɗin gini.

card.title: Farashin AppSheet na Nneka na wata-wata
rows: Mai farawa: 4 masu amfani a $5 US

say: Abokan ciniki ba safai suke neman app ba. Suna neman a daina asarar haja, ko don sanin wane mahayi ya kawo abin. Zaɓi alkuki, nau'in abokin ciniki da nau'in app, don haka ginin ku na biyu yana sake amfani da farkon ku.
Fara tare da nasara mai sauri: ƙima mai girma, ƙaramin ƙoƙari, kamar mai bin diddigin hannun jari tare da teburi uku.

panel.heading: Inda aikin biya yake

Aika mahaya da dabaru

say: Kafin ka faɗi, duba shafin farashi na hukuma ranar. Wasu katunan naira suna toshe cajin ƙasashen waje akai-akai, don haka tambayi abokin ciniki ya gwada biyan kuɗi da wuri.

Kuma asibitoci, masu ba da lamuni da ƙungiyoyin tanadi suna riƙe da bayanai masu mahimmanci. Karkashin Dokar Kare Bayanai ta Najeriya 2023, tattara abin da ake bukata kawai a kiyaye shi. Fara da hannun jari, ayyuka da ƙa'idodin dabaru.

Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
